verdict.rationale: An agent can create campaigns through the Create Campaign API and the official MCP server, whose documented example is "Create an email campaign promoting our Memorial Day sale." Klaviyo's in-app Composer builds the audience and drafts content "for your review… with you in control," which implies a human checkpoint. No evidence explicitly shows an external agent targeting a segment and leaving the campaign in a draft, scheduled or approval-pending state that blocks sending until a human approves. Missing for 10: documented draft/unsent campaign state via API/MCP, explicit segment/audience targeting in campaign creation, approval-gate or scheduled-send controls, hands-on corroboration.
